materialChangesThisRun.detail: GitHub main still contained a literal PLACEHOLDER for Minecraft Recommendations Vault - Explorer.html even though an authenticated staged payload existed. The publication workflow was repaired to trigger on current-explorer staging changes, validate dynamic staged parts, and verify remote output against the staged manifest instead of stale hard-coded artifact identities. A second defect was then isolated: the staged build JSON was 673 bytes / SHA-256 ccf6717a356cf57f14fb3ebd067fe609ca3a1f4cb92827037fbd4be68d6b1e67 while the manifest still declared an obsolete 676-byte identity. The manifest was corrected and the workflow completed successfully.

Workflow run 33291849597 completed successfully and published commit c8189b90bf448c63654e084904f8499fe71d5ece. The workflow independently fetched the remote branch and verified the Explorer, build JSON, reusable builder, provenance fields, and acceptance markers. Explorer identity: 374830 bytes / SHA-256 ea1a6b64bab80bc88521ec138f2e364fbeeebb1d2c2796aaebc520ece9c0f979. Build metadata identity: 673 bytes / SHA-256 ccf6717a356cf57f14fb3ebd067fe609ca3a1f4cb92827037fbd4be68d6b1e67.
